description: This file is a shell script for testing git repository behavior when the repository is unwritable. It defines test scenarios to check git commands' error handling in permission-restricted environments.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test scenario expecting success, running commands and verifying outcomes.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail, used to test error conditions.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test's internal timestamp or state to facilitate testing sequences.
